title: Renewal and Cancellation Figures for CareLine Service Plans
content:
Customer terms schedule for the CareLine Service Plans family, setting the renewal and cancellation figures of each tier.

### Renewal figures

| Tier | Most a renewal plan fee can rise above the fee last paid for a term, before discounts | New plan set to renew automatically | Holder told of the coming renewal and its fee, at least this many calendar days before the term end date | Calendar days after renewal within which an unpaid renewal fee may be paid before the plan expires |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 5% (0.05) | No | 30 | 30 |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 5% (0.05) | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 5% (0.05) | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 5% (0.05) | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 5% (0.05) | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 5% (0.05) | Yes | 30 | 30 |

### Cancellation figures

| Tier | Free-look period after the start of a term (calendar days) | Fee deducted from a prorated refund after the free-look period (USD) | How a later refund is figured |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 30 | 0.00 | Unused full months |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 30 | 25.00 | Unused full months |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 30 | 25.00 | Unused full months |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 30 | 25.00 | Unused full months |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 30 | 50.00 | Unused full months |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 30 | 25.00 | Unused full months |

**Unused full months**, on every tier, refunds the term's plan fee multiplied by the full months remaining in the term and divided by the months in the term.

**Free-look period**, on every tier: within 30 calendar days after the start of a term the plan can be cancelled for a full refund of that term's fee, if no visit was used in that term.

### Reading the cap (hypothetical fees)

With the cap of 5% on every tier, a fee last paid of 200.00 for a term, before discounts, allows a renewal plan fee of at most 210.00 — 200.00 plus 5% of 200.00.

### Reading the automatic-renewal setting

A new CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate plan is set to renew automatically when it is opened; a new On-Call Service Account is not.
